implemented: Recovered the worker's only unfinished store patch: optional checkpoint original timestamp, normalized and future timestamps rejected.
Checkpoint capacity eviction orders by original timestamp, preventing late ancient imports from evicting newer evidence.
Existing project goals, reference validation, atomic persistence, scoped forget and retention remain intact.
interfaces: ProductivityStore.apply({op:'checkpoint.add', title, note?, capsuleId?, refs?, createdAt?}) accepts optional original date. Omit createdAt for current time. No shared contract change required for the store's existing unknown operation payload.
limitations: No additional renderer workbench or import UI was completed by this worker; this change adds store support only.
Changing retention policy stores policy only; deletion occurs through existing explicit applyRetention or reload.
Search/recap behavior remains existing exact local evidence-based behavior; no semantic embedding or cloud memory feature added.
Imported dates older than the newest 1000 checkpoints can be discarded immediately by the bounded store.
